Modification: decoded the original author's RLE bitmap to a 1024 x 1024
8-bit grayscale-plus-alpha PNG. The bitmap pixels are unchanged from the
original author's decoder. This generated image replaces the unannotated
PNG copy from the Libretro Newpixie preset, with the same visible pixels
and alpha (only RGB values of fully transparent pixels differ).

The shader pass files retain their own original MIT/Unlicense notices and
Mattias Gustavsson / hunterk credits; this frame notice does not replace them.
